summary: Drops the laravel/vapor-core package: the public POST /vapor/signed-storage-url upload-signing controller now builds the S3 presigned PUT itself (same key tmp/<uuid>, ACL, content-type and headers as Vapor's code) with the expiry setting moved to filesystems.signed_storage_url_expires_after (5 min); also bumps symfony/mime and the @intlify i18n build tooling for security fixes. api/vapor.yml (production Vapor config) is left in place but can no longer deploy without vapor-core.

statements.why: Both 'decisions' are false scope alarms; there is nothing to decide about these files.

statements.text: ? The agent also changed api/app/Http/Controllers/Content/SignedStorageUrlController.php, which doesn't look related to what you asked for. (This is a guess.)
statements.why: This controller is the only code that used Vapor Core (it extended Laravel\Vapor\...\SignedStorageUrlController); rewriting it is the core of 'Remove Vapor Core from storage upload signing'.

statements.text: ? The agent also changed api/config/filesystems.php, which doesn't look related to what you asked for. (This is a guess.)
statements.why: It adds signed_storage_url_expires_after, replacing config('vapor.signed_storage_url_expires_after') that went away with Vapor Core; directly related.

statements.text: • The vapor signed storage URL part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what it does differently. /vapor/signed-storage-url
statements.why: Correct endpoint (api/routes/api.php:561), but no explanation; behaviour is intended to be identical.
Removes laravel/vapor-core and its deps (hollodotme/fast-cgi-client, riverline/multipart-parser) and bumps symfony/mime 7.4.19 -> 7.4.22; not explained.
True, but the card doesn't relay what the new section says: uploads no longer use vapor-core and api/vapor.yml deployments need it restored.

statements.text: (Hidden: 1 file with only formatting changes, or lockfiles.)
statements.why: client/package-lock.json is a lockfile; it does carry the @intlify i18n security bumps, which the card never mentions (see misses).

misses.what: If you deploy with Laravel Vapor (api/vapor.yml with api-production is still in the repo), deployments will no longer work until laravel/vapor-core is restored; the commit's own docs (docker.mdx, now listed by the card) say so, but the card doesn't. Docker/self-hosted installs are unaffected.

Card doesn't explain the actual change: file uploads to S3 storage are now signed by the app itself instead of the Vapor package, meant to behave the same; upload links still expire after 5 minutes (now set in filesystems.php).
Security updates to dependencies: symfony/mime 7.4.19 -> 7.4.22 and the @intlify i18n compiler tooling (vue-i18n-extensions 8 -> 9, which requires Node 22+ for builds).
